title: Worksheet favourites speed-dial
summary: TpT 'filing cabinet' pattern. Star-icon affordance on every library row writes a row to a new worksheet_favourite table; a sidebar 'Recently favourited' speed-dial on the Worksheets generator page pre-fills the form from a chosen favourite's params. Server-side endpoints + AppContext action + UI affordance.
motivation: TpT's filing cabinet is the most-praised non-AI ergonomic feature in the review corpus. Teachers regenerate the same shape of worksheet weekly — the favourite is the input config, NOT the output bytes, so re-running gives a fresh worksheet on the same shape.

in: server/db/schema.sql — new table worksheet_favourite (school_id, user_id, worksheet_id, label, created_at) + index on (school_id, user_id)
client/src/contexts/AppContext.tsx — favourites: Map<worksheetId, FavouriteRecord> + toggleFavourite(worksheetId, label?) action
client/src/components/Worksheets/Sidebar.tsx (or extend the existing sidebar) — 'Recently favourited' chip list
client/src/components/StarToggle.tsx (new, ~60 LoC) — reusable star-icon affordance + tooltip
Targeted vitest: server endpoint contract; AppContext optimistic update; star-toggle accessibility (aria-pressed)
out: Cross-school favourite sharing (deferred — privacy review needed)
Favourite tagging / folders (deferred — single label string is enough for v1)
Favourite-as-template (the favourite stores the input config; G3 archetypes are a separate first-class concept)

acceptance_criteria: Toggling the star on a library row inserts/deletes a worksheet_favourite row scoped to the current school + user.
Sidebar 'Recently favourited' shows up to 8 chips, ordered by created_at DESC.
Clicking a favourite chip pre-fills the Worksheets generator form (subject, yearGroup, topic, sendNeed, examBoard, difficulty, archetype if any) — does NOT auto-submit.
Schema is append-only and IF NOT EXISTS so re-runs are safe.
Optimistic update — UI flips immediately; server call rolls back on failure with a toast.

risk_register.risk: Favourite worksheet's source params drift over time (e.g. school changes default exam board)
risk_register.mitigation: Favourite stores a snapshot of the params at favouriting time; re-using a favourite from 6 months ago surfaces a 'these defaults may be stale' notice.

risk_register.risk: favourite_count grows unbounded for power users
risk_register.mitigation: Soft cap at 50 per user; UI shows 'Limit reached — un-favourite older entries' when at cap.

related: G3 — lesson archetypes (a favourite can capture an archetype + topic combo)
